graph.name: Larval MB circuit · eight neurons with measured 3D skeletons

source.title: Eight identity-linked larval mushroom-body neurons
source.release: Pedigo elife-v5, commit4482b9022f27, eight-ID induced subset
source.license: MIT for pinned research repository and processed files; original Winding et al. Science article CC BY 4.0
source.scope: Induced subset of the pinned Pedigo network, restricted to eight neurons with bundled VFB L1EM skeletons. The connection rows measure structural synaptic counts; neuron-to-neuron connectors drawn by an app are schematic because exact synapse coordinates are not supplied. Geometry and edge exports have distinct snapshot dates.
source.limits: Eight measured geometries share VFB_00050000. IDs match the pinned larval graph. Geometry exports dated May 2025; connectivity from elife-v5 2023. Counts do not establish dynamics or represent all partners of these cells.

metadataEvidence.scope: Authoritative VFB per-neuron licenses, image templates and original external IDs; captured response bytes included.

manifest.scope: Geometry and connectivity identify the same specimen/cell IDs; distinct exports may differ in proofreading state. Do not treat skeleton intersection or schematic edges as spatial synapse evidence.
